question: Related Questions Q. As you aware that there is lot of resturant,hotels etc who served chiken & mutton dishes,claiming that they are using HALAL chicken or Mutton. Just take an example,,KFC is world famous reataurant,some branches in delhi & other metro cities,who usually serve chicken dishes,,once,I visited the restaurant in Cannaught Place. Before having some chicken item,I asked the manager about the chicken,what type of the chicken they are using in the restaurant ??? He confirmed me that we are using only HALAL chicken in their stores in india. & also got a certificate from Jama masjid stating that KFC use only HALAL chicken in their stores in india. Now,Some days back,I visited their UK site, i.e. http://www.kfc.co.uk/faqs.aspx ,,on this link,there is question that chicken used i KFC is HALAL or not...then answer as mentioned on site is (Unfortunately we currently do not use Halal chicken in any of our stores.). answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 2597 Country: Canada Title: Is Shark meat allowed to eat? 2. In some places people raise cat fish in sceptic tanks which contains human feces and waste. The catfish eats human waste and other garbage. Is it allowed to eat such fish? Question: Is Shark meat allowed to eat? 2. In some places people raise cat fish in sceptic tanks which contains human feces and waste. The catfish eats human waste and other garbage. Is it allowed to eat such fish? Answer ID: 2597 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 17/17=B) (1, 2) If the zoologists, linguists and people consider them as fish and they fall in the category of fish then undoubtedly it is allowed to eat them even though they live on anything. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
